On August 4, 2026, Ingredion Incorporated (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing the Company’s condensed consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (the “Press Release”). A copy of the Company’s Press Release is being furnished as Exhibit 99 and hereby incorporated by reference. The Company will host a conference call Tuesday, August 4, 2026 at 8 a.m. CT/ 9 a.m. ET to discuss the second quarter financial results.
